summary: Tested owner-editable Homepage hero caption feature (hero_label, hero_tagline) end-to-end. All 5 backend pytest cases pass and the frontend flow verified in browser: owner updates fields in Owner settings → save → public homepage /  (no login) shows the updated caption. Defaults restored after test.

issues: Tagline input is much wider than Small label input; visually inconsistent. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/admin/settings correctly only updates non-None provided fields (regression test confirms fee/refund/threshold/hold/toggles preserved when saving hero fields).
Owner-only guard (require_owner) works: admin@komorebi.cafe gets 403 as expected.
GET /api/settings/public exposes hero_label & hero_tagline with proper defaults.
test_credentials: Owner sabnamrajoria@gmail.com/Owner@123 and admin admin@komorebi.cafe/Admin@123 both worked.
seed_data_creation: None. Hero fields set to QA values during test then reset to defaults ('Now serving' / 'Afternoon light & golden evenings').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_hero_caption.py. Run with: pytest backend/tests/test_hero_caption.py -o addopts='' (project pytest.ini uses xdist-loadscope which cannot run single files without -o addopts=''). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL must be exported in shell (not just in frontend/.env).
